description: This file contains unit tests for the ReadWriteLock class, testing basic read/write locking functionality using the Google Test framework.

classes.name: ReadWriteLock
classes.description: A class representing a read-write lock mechanism, used for synchronizing access in concurrent scenarios.

methods.name: ReadLock
methods.description: Acquires a read lock, allowing multiple readers but blocking writers.

methods.name: ReadUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired read lock.

methods.name: WriteLock
methods.description: Acquires a write lock, exclusive access for writing.

methods.name: WriteUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired write lock.
